description: This file declares functions and macros for the firmware upgrade hardware abstraction layer (HAL) related to the SSP TDK FW upgrade process. It provides function prototypes for getting and setting upgrade parameters, handling download operations, rebooting, and managing URLs, with support for C++ linkage.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value based on the provided parameter name.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Set_Download_Interface
methods.description: Sets the download interface used for firmware update.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Reboot_Now
methods.description: Reboots the device immediately after firmware upgrade.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Get_Download_Url
methods.description: Retrieves the download URL and filename.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_Set_Download_Url
methods.description: Sets the download URL and filename.

methods.name: ssp_FWUPGRADEHAL_UpdateAndFactoryReset
methods.description: Performs an update and factory reset using specified URL and name.
